notes: Live check of https://www.studyinnl.org/finances/holland-scholarship (Nuffic, official NL Scholarship platform) confirms this is a national Dutch government scheme 'financed by the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science as well as several Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences'.
